blocks.text: Jab circuit mein aik se zyada capacitors aapas mein jore jayein to isay capacitors ka combination kehte hain. Yeh apni marzi ki capacitance hasil karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Aisa group (majmua) aik akele equivalent (barabar) capacitor ki tarah kaam karta hai, aur us ki capacitance ko combined capacitance kehte hain. Do aam combinations hain:

Is tareeqe mein tamam capacitors ki aik taraf ki plates battery ke negative terminal se aur doosri taraf ki plates positive terminal se jori jati hain (Fig. 16.8). Battery plates ko charge karti hai. Har capacitor par potential difference V barabar hai (sab aik hi do taaron ke darmiyan hain), lekin charge har aik par us ki capacitance ke hisaab se alag hai. Agar C₁, C₂ aur C₃ par charges Q₁, Q₂ aur Q₃ hon, to equivalent capacitor C_e par charge Q teenon ke kul charge ke barabar hoga, usi V par (Fig. 16.8 b). Is liye:

blocks.alt: Do circuits. (a) Battery (oopar +, neeche -) aur oopar aur neeche ke taaron ke darmiyan saath saath jure capacitors C1, C2 aur C3, yani parallel mein. (b) Wahi battery aur aik equivalent (barabar) capacitor Ce.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.8: (a) Battery ke saath parallel mein C1, C2 aur C3; (b) equivalent capacitor Ce (kitab ki Figure 16.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ab Q = CV har aik ke liye rakhein:

blocks.text_alt: Q₁ = C₁V, Q₂ = C₂V, Q₃ = C₃V and Q = C_eV,

blocks.title: Parallel combination
blocks.text: Parallel mein jure capacitors ki combined capacitance un ki alag alag capacitances ke jor (sum) ke barabar hoti hai. Parallel mein jorne se capacitance barhti hai.

blocks.title: Example 16.5
blocks.problem: 80 pF ka capacitor 48 volt tak charge kiya gaya. Phir is ki plates aik doosre (khali) capacitor se parallel mein jori gayin. Ab combination par potential difference 30 volt hai. Doosre capacitor ki capacitance kitni hai?
steps: Jorne se pehle C₁ ka charge, Q = CV se:
Jorne ke baad dono par V₂ = 30 V
Ab C₁ par charge Q₁′ = C₁V₂ = 80 × 10⁻¹² F × 30 V = 2400 × 10⁻¹² C

Kul charge wahi rehta hai (charge na banta hai na khatam hota hai), is liye C₂ par gaya charge:
Q₂ = Q₁ − Q₁′ = 3840 × 10⁻¹² C − 2400 × 10⁻¹² C = 1440 × 10⁻¹² C

blocks.text: Series mein capacitors aik line mein aik ke baad aik jore jate hain (Fig. 16.9 a). C₁ ki doosri plate C₂ ki pehli plate se juri hai, aur C₂ ki doosri plate C₃ ki pehli plate se. C₁ ki pehli plate aur C₃ ki doosri plate battery se juri hain.

blocks.alt: Do circuits. (a) Oopar ke taar mein aik ke baad aik capacitors C1, C2 aur C3, yani series mein, aur neeche ke taar mein battery (baen taraf +). (b) Wahi battery aur aik equivalent capacitor Ce.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.9: (a) Battery ke saath series mein C1, C2 aur C3; (b) equivalent capacitor Ce (kitab ki Figure 16.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Battery C₁ ki pehli plate ko +Q charge deti hai. C₁ ki doosri plate pehli plate se insulated (alag) hai, is liye woh battery se charge nahi le sakti. Lekin pehli plate ka +Q doosri plate par barabar −Q induce karta hai (paida karta hai). C₂ ki pehli plate C₁ ki doosri plate se juri hai, is liye wahan +Q aa jata hai. Isi tarah C₃ bhi charge hota hai. Yun har capacitor ki har plate par charge ki magnitude (miqdar) Q hi hoti hai.

Fig. 16.9 (b) dikhati hai ke teenon ke combination par potential difference battery ke V ke barabar hai. Lekin series mein har capacitor par V nahi; har aik par us ki capacitance ke hisaab se alag voltage hai. Agar un par V₁, V₂ aur V₃ hon, to:
Agar C_e equivalent capacitor ki capacitance ho to us par bhi charge Q hoga, aur us par potential difference poore combination wala V hoga.
C = Q/V, yani V = Q/C, se:

blocks.text_alt: V = Q/C_e, V₁ = Q/C₁, V₂ = Q/C₂ and V₃ = Q/C₃

blocks.text: Dono taraf Q se divide karein:

blocks.title: Series combination
blocks.text: Series mein jure capacitors ki equivalent capacitance ka reciprocal (ulat, 1/C) alag alag capacitances ke reciprocals ke jor ke barabar hai. Is liye C_e series ki sab se chhoti capacitance se bhi kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 16.6
blocks.problem:
12 μF aur 4 μF ke do capacitors 80 V battery se series mein jore gaye hain.
(i) Combination mein kul charge kitna hai?
(ii) Har capacitor par potential difference kitna hai?
steps: (ii) Series mein har capacitor par wahi Q hai. V₁ = Q/C₁ = 2.4 × 10⁻⁴ C/12 × 10⁻⁶ F = 20 V

blocks.prompt: Aap ke paas do 6 μF capacitors hain. In se kaun kaun si capacitances banayi ja sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: 6 μF (aik akela), 12 μF (dono parallel mein: 6 + 6) aur 3 μF (dono series mein: 1/C = 1/6 + 1/6 = 1/3).

items: Parallel: har aik par V barabar; C_e = C₁ + C₂ + C₃.
Series: har aik par Q barabar; V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃; 1/C_e = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ + 1/C₃.
Charged capacitor ko doosre se jorne par kul charge wahi rehta hai.
